problem_statement: ZMS needs a mount operation that recovers a corrupted or otherwise unmountable partition: when a normal mount fails because the stored data uses an unsupported ZMS version, a force-mount variant should automatically wipe the partition, reinitialize it, and succeed. After such a forced mount the file system must be fully usable again (entries can be written and read back). The ordinary mount must still return the unsupported-version error and not attempt recovery.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/subsys/kvss/zms -s tests/subsys/kvss/zms/keyvalstorage.zms -s keyvalstorage.zms -O twister-out --no-clean -W
